record.summary: A read-mostly single-page app served same-origin by the daemon (built assets embedded, statecraft pattern): DAG view with status, readiness, blockers, and invalidation; live run view with current spec, stage, and streaming session output over SSE; quota state with time-to-reset (estimates marked); searchable decision-ledger browser; run history with the per-spec evidence trail (PR, CI result, verify verdict, costs); and the control verbs the API exposes, each with a confirmation that names what will be journaled. It is an observability surface, not a wizard: every number on screen is traceable to a journal record or an evidence file.
record.title: Localhost web UI: the observability surface
